acip: SKYON MED DE, DE'I DON LCAGS SREG LA SOGS PA DE DAG DBANG PHYUG RTAG PA SOGS KYIS BLO'I G-YO BA SNGON DU BTANG NAS BYAS PA MA YIN PAR DER SKYES PA'I 'GRO BA'I SDIG SEMS BYED PA POR BSTAN PA'I PHYIR,
english: Yet there is no such problem. The point of this quotation is to say that the burning steel and so on are not something that was created by some unchanging creator being or something like that; by someone who thought it over first and then created them. The lines are meant to show us that what really made all these things is the non-virtuous states of mind had by the beings who have to take birth there.
